objective: Implement 16-bit sorting exercise 6 on Intel 8086 architecture.
theory: The Intel 8086 is a 16-bit CISC microprocessor with a 20-bit address bus capable of addressing 1 MB of memory divided into Code, Data, Stack, and Extra segments.
algorithm: 1. Load 16-bit data from memory offset 2050H into AX register.
2. Load immediate 16-bit value 0006H into BX register.
flowchart: START -> Execute Sorting Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
; 8086 Assembly - Sorting Ex 6
MOV AX, [2050H]
MOV BX, 0006H
ADD AX, BX
MOV [2052H], AX
INT 20H
step_by_step_execution: Step 1: Fetch and decode Sorting instruction for Intel 8086.
Step 2: Read input operands from memory / registers.
Step 3: Execute ALU operation for Sorting.
Step 4: Update status flags (Z, CY, S, P).
Step 5: Store final result into memory.
explanation: This program demonstrates sorting on the Intel 8086 architecture.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to clear carry or flags before loop.
